    /** One step of the random walk: an action and the parameters it is called with. */
    public record Step(String action, Map<String, Object> params) {
    }

    /**
     * The conformance property: the implementation must behave like the spec
     * on every sequence of actions that is tried.
     *
     * <p>A green run is conformance evidence, not a proof: it says that every
     * sequence drawn here matched the spec, not that every possible sequence
     * would.
     */
    @Property(tries = 200)
    public void theAdapterConformsToTheSpec(@ForAll("steps") List<Step> steps) {
        VeriSpecAdapter adapter = newAdapter();
        adapter.reset();
        Map<String, Object> state = new LinkedHashMap<>(adapter.snapshot());

        Assertions.assertEquals(SPEC_INIT.keySet(), state.keySet(),
                "the snapshot must contain exactly the spec's variables");
        Assertions.assertTrue(VeriSpecValues.equalMaps(SPEC_INIT, state),
                "after reset() expected " + SPEC_INIT + " but got " + state);
        checkInvariants(state, "after reset()");

        int step = 0;
        for (Step current : steps) {
            if (!requires(current.action(), state, current.params())) {
                // The precondition does not hold: the action is not enabled,
                // so it is skipped.  A run may also stutter.
                step++;
                continue;
            }
            Map<String, Object> expected = effects(current.action(), state, current.params());
            adapter.apply(current.action(), current.params());
            Map<String, Object> actual = new LinkedHashMap<>(adapter.snapshot());
            Assertions.assertTrue(VeriSpecValues.equalMaps(expected, actual),
                    "step " + step + " action " + current.action() + " " + current.params()
                            + ": expected " + expected + " but got " + actual
                            + " (prev=" + state + ")");
            checkInvariants(actual, "step " + step);
            state = actual;
            step++;
        }
    }
